description: End-to-end telco core network optimization workflow from opportunity identification to implementation, monitoring, and rollback within an order-to-cash context.

optimization_opportunity_id.description: Identifier of a detected optimization opportunity (e.g., congestion hotspot, underutilized segment).

optimization_plan_id.description: Identifier of a proposed optimization plan bundling multiple changes.

change_order_id.description: Identifier of a formal change order associated with an optimization plan.

implementation_batch_id.description: Identifier of a batch of configuration changes scheduled/executed together.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier of a rollback plan tied to an implementation batch or change order.

topology_slice_id.description: Identifier for a logical subset of the network topology (e.g., region, cluster, slice).

kpi_profile_id.description: Identifier for a KPI profile defining target thresholds and weights.

approval_request_id.description: Identifier for an approval request for a change or optimization plan.

simulation_run_id.description: Identifier for a simulation run used to predict optimization impact.

incident_id.description: Identifier of a network incident potentially caused or mitigated by an optimization.

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: discover_optimization_opportunities
functions.description: Scan network telemetry and business data to discover candidate optimization opportunities across the core network.

time_window.description: Time window over which to analyze telemetry.

topology_scope.description: Scope of the network to analyze.

topology_slice_id.description: Predefined topology slice identifier to restrict analysis.

node_types.description: Types of nodes to focus on.

kpi_filters.description: Minimum performance degradation thresholds to consider as opportunities.

utilization_above.description: Minimum average utilization percentage to flag congestion.

p95_latency_ms_above.description: Minimum p95 latency threshold in ms.

availability_below.description: Availability percentage below which to flag issues.

business_impact_weights.description: Weighting of business impact dimensions for ranking opportunities.

max_results.description: Maximum number of opportunities to return.

functions.returns: List of detected optimization opportunities with optimization_opportunity_id, scope, severity, and business impact score.

functions.name: get_optimization_opportunity_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed telemetry, topology, and business context for a specific optimization opportunity.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response.

telemetry_window_override.description: Optional override for telemetry time window.

functions.returns: Full details for the optimization opportunity including kpis, affected topology, subscriber segments, and related incidents.

functions.name: create_optimization_plan
functions.description: Create a structured optimization plan for a given opportunity, defining proposed changes and expected impact.

name.description: Human-readable name for the optimization plan.

description.description: Detailed description of the proposed optimization.

kpi_profile_id.description: KPI profile to use for success evaluation.

proposed_changes.description: List of proposed configuration or routing changes.

depends_on_change_ids.description: IDs of other changes in this plan that must be executed first.

business_case.description: High-level business case for this plan.

estimated_churn_impact.description: Estimated change in churn rate in percentage points.

functions.returns: Created optimization_plan_id with initial status, list of changes, and validation requirements.

functions.name: simulate_optimization_impact
functions.description: Run network simulation to estimate the impact of an optimization plan before scheduling implementation.

failure_injection.description: Optional failure scenarios to test resilience.

kpi_profile_id.description: KPI profile to apply during simulation.

functions.returns: simulation_run_id and projected KPI deltas, risk indicators, and recommendation to proceed or revise.

functions.name: request_optimization_approval
functions.description: Create an approval request for an optimization plan, including simulation results and business case.

simulation_run_id.description: Simulation run supporting this approval request.

change_order_reference.description: Optional linkage to an existing or draft change order.

approver_groups.description: Groups that must approve the plan.

functions.returns: approval_request_id with current approval status, required approvers, and linked change_order_id if created.

functions.name: get_approval_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current approval status for an optimization plan or specific approval request.

approval_request_id.description: Approval request identifier. Required if optimization_plan_id not provided.

optimization_plan_id.description: Plan identifier. Used to fetch the latest related approval if approval_request_id not provided.

functions.returns: Current approval state, per-group decisions, comments, and any blocking issues.

functions.name: schedule_implementation_batch
functions.description: Create and schedule an implementation batch for approved optimization changes and link it to a change order.

change_order_id.description: Existing change order ID, if any. If omitted, a new order may be created depending on policy.

batching_rules.description: Rules for grouping changes into sub-batches.

notification_channels.description: Channels to notify before and after implementation.

functions.returns: implementation_batch_id with schedule, linked change_order_id, and derived execution sub-batches.

functions.name: execute_implementation_batch
functions.description: Trigger execution of a scheduled implementation batch and monitor real-time progress.

override_safety_checks.description: Optional overrides for pre-execution safety checks.

functions.returns: Execution start confirmation with initial status, expected milestones, and real-time monitoring endpoint.

functions.name: get_implementation_status
functions.description: Get current status, progress, and any incidents related to an implementation batch.
functions.returns: Current batch status, success/failure per change or node (depending on detail_level), kpi deltas, and linked incident_ids if any.

functions.name: pause_or_cancel_implementation
functions.description: Pause or cancel an in-progress implementation batch, optionally triggering rollback.

scope.description: Scope of rollback for partial mode.

functions.returns: Updated implementation status, created rollback_plan_id if applicable, and next recommended actions.

functions.name: create_rollback_plan
functions.description: Create an explicit rollback plan for an optimization, either pre-implementation or after a failure.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source entity (optimization_plan_id, implementation_batch_id, or change_order_id).

selection_criteria.description: Criteria for selecting what to roll back.

pre_checks.description: Checks that must pass before rollback.

functions.returns: rollback_plan_id with list of planned reverse changes, risk assessment, and required approvals if any.

functions.name: retry_failed_changes
functions.description: Retry failed changes from an implementation batch with adjusted parameters or alternative strategy.

fallback_rollback_plan_id.description: Existing rollback plan to invoke if retries fail.

functions.returns: New retry execution summary with per-change retry status and whether fallback rollback was triggered.

functions.name: evaluate_post_implementation_kpis
functions.description: Evaluate KPIs after implementation to determine if the optimization met success criteria and update related change order state.

kpi_profile_id.description: KPI profile to use. If omitted, the profile associated with the plan is used.

analysis_window.description: Time window for post-implementation KPI analysis.

before_hours.description: Hours before implementation to use as baseline.

after_hours.description: Hours after implementation to measure impact.

functions.returns: KPI evaluation report with success/failure verdict, detailed deltas by dimension, and updated change_order_id status if applicable.

functions.name: search_core_optimization_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across core_optimization entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching core_optimization entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_core_optimization_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N core_optimization records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_core_optimization_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many core_optimization records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_core_optimization_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many core_optimization records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_core_optimization_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of core_optimization data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_core_optimization_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a core_optimization dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_core_optimization_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more core_optimization entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_core_optimization_snapshot
functions.description: Restore core_optimization state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_core_optimization_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the core_optimization workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_core_optimization_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across core_optimization metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_core_optimization_audit_events
functions.description: Search the core_optimization audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_core_optimization_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers core_optimization workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_core_optimization_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for core_optimization events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_core_optimization_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for core_optimization events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_core_optimization_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off core_optimization job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_core_optimization_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled core_optimization jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_core_optimization_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled core_optimization job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_core_optimization_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a core_optimization operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_core_optimization_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a core_optimization action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_core_optimization_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a core_optimization approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_core_optimization_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any core_optimization entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_core_optimization_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a core_optimization entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_core_optimization_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling core_optimization behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_core_optimization_policies
functions.description: List core_optimization policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_core_optimization_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two core_optimization-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_core_optimization_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a core_optimization entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_core_optimization_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many core_optimization entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
